behaviorChecks.expectedStateChange: 点击引起可见的起跳/翻转；碰到可切物时发生切割
behaviorChecks.spatialRelationship: 刀、首个目标与承托面同时可辨；引导不遮住目标

behaviorChecks.objectType: overlapping cuttable stack and its support
behaviorChecks.stateBranch: intact overlap → blade contact → cut/separate → unsupported falling
behaviorChecks.playerInput: 正常点击接触可见堆叠；另一次重玩尝试避开

behaviorChecks.objectType: cut object + local reward + cumulative HUD
behaviorChecks.stateBranch: contact → cut completed → separated → reward → total sync
behaviorChecks.playerInput: 正常点击完成一次切割后观察
behaviorChecks.expectedStateChange: 完成切割并分离后，在该物体附近播放奖励反馈，再同步累计值
behaviorChecks.spatialRelationship: 奖励附着于切割发生位置；总计显示不替代局部反馈

behaviorChecks.stateBranch: warning → approach → collision/avoidance → failure or recovery
behaviorChecks.playerInput: 看到危险后调整点击节奏；失败后使用可见重试入口
behaviorChecks.expectedStateChange: 危险在接近前可辨；避开与接触后果不同；失败原因和重试入口可见
behaviorChecks.spatialRelationship: 危险信号与真正危险物体绑定；装饰和危险不使用无法区分的表现

visibleFeedback.anchor: 危险物体、碰撞点及重试入口

behaviorChecks.spatialRelationship: 结果区处于场景中并与刀的接触一致；覆盖层不提前遮住选择
